description: The SK-01 RTO is the primary transport office for Gangtok, the capital of Sikkim. It manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport permits for the East Sikkim region, operating out of the Yatayat Bhawan.
address: Yatayat Bhawan, SNT Complex, Gangtok, East Sikkim, Sikkim - 737101

description: The SK-02 RTO serves the Gyalshing district in West Sikkim, facilitating vehicle registration and driving licensing services. It is the primary transport administrative body for the western part of the state, ensuring compliance with the Motor Vehicles Act across various mountainous terrains.
address: Regional Transport Office, Gyalshing, West Sikkim, Sikkim

description: The SK-03 RTO serves the Mangan district (formerly North Sikkim), handling essential transport services including vehicle registration and driving license issuance. It is the primary transport authority for the geographically vast and mountainous northern region of Sikkim.
address: Regional Transport Office, Mangan, North Sikkim, Sikkim - 737116

description: The SK-04 RTO is located in Jorethang and serves as the nodal office for vehicle registration and licensing in the South Sikkim district. It manages the issuance of driving licenses, fitness certificates for commercial vehicles, and the collection of road taxes for the southern region of the state.

SK-05 is the Regional Transport Office serving the Namchi district in Sikkim. It was officially designated as a separate registration authority to manage vehicle services for the Namchi town and its immediate subdivisions, distinct from the Jorethang RTO.
address: Regional Transport Office, Transport Department, Namchi, Sikkim

description: SK-06 is the Regional Transport Office for the Soreng district in Sikkim, facilitating vehicle registration and driving licenses. This RTO was established to serve the administrative needs of the Soreng district, ensuring efficient transport services for the local population in the western region.
address: Soreng Bazar, Above SBS (Sikkim Bank Ltd), Soreng, Sikkim

description: The SK-07 Regional Transport Office (RTO) serves the Pakyong district, which was officially carved out of East Sikkim. This office manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport permits for the Pakyong and Rongli sub-divisions, facilitating local governance in the newly formed district.
address: Regional Transport Office, Pakyong District, Sikkim

description: The SK-08 RTO serves the Singtam region within the Gangtok district of Sikkim. This office was established as part of the state's administrative expansion to facilitate vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and transport tax collection for the Singtam sub-division.
address: Regional Transport Office, Singtam, Gangtok District, Sikkim
